results.text: Reduction of LDL cholesterol by pravastatin does not influence platelet activation in patients with mild hypercholesterolaemia at risk of coronary heart disease. The effect of pravastatin on low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol and platelet activation was studied in 16 patients with mild hypercholesterolaemia who had two or more additional cardiovascular risk factors. Pravastatin treatment of very low density, intermediate density and low density lipoproteins in hypercholesterolemia and combined hyperlipidemia secondary to the nephrotic syndrome. In the current study pravastatin was used in nephrotic syndrome patients with hypercholesterolemia and combined hyperlipidemia to test whether the drug decreases production of LDL and reduces levels of VLDL and IDL.
